text:
Hi, I understand you need someone to take ownership of Amazon PPC across Europe and the USA, keep ACOS near 20%, and provide clear weekly reporting without needing micromanagement.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’ve built a Power BI sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture that consolidated 14 separate Excel reports into one and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. I also built an Excel/Power Query inventory reconciliation workflow for Coastline Hardware that found $86k in stock variance and cut weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

My process is to review the account data, identify issues and opportunities, track changes in a weekly report, and stay aligned through regular check-ins. I can commit steady weekly hours and adapt to your reporting cadence, including calls every 2 weeks.
